name: bias_battery_extra_rest_edge_opener
hypothesis: Team's rest minus opponent's rest >= 4 days -- subset cover rate vs. complement. Opener-grade re-screen of an already-recorded close-graded cell; mined family, uncorrected multiplicity; recorded for direction and pooling, not as a finding.

reliability_check.reason: extra_rest_edge is a per-game situational condition (this game's own rest differential), not a persistent per-team trait -- there is nothing to split-half.
